hypothesis: Wave D14 (C_L3_OPENNESS_LAYER3): a system cut off from its supply loses its layer-3 pool as R = R_ss exp(-delta t), with a constant specific loss rate. Applied to a fasting body living on its reserves (after the first days of a long fast), body mass should fall with a specific loss rate that stays near constant as the body shrinks; constant burn predicts it rises by the ratio of the masses, and a strongly adapting metabolism predicts it falls well below constant.

observable.quantity: r = k_late / k_early, the specific body-mass loss rate in the late half of phase II over that in the early half; compared with r_lin = mean mass early / mean mass late
observable.domain: one human subject (L.) during a 31-day water-only fast, Benedict (1915) A Study of Prolonged Fasting, Carnegie Institution of Washington Publication 203, daily naked morning body weight from the chapter 'Body-weight'; days 1-5 of the fast excluded

prediction_method.description: Daily (day of fast, naked body weight in kg) points for L. transcribed after approval from Benedict 1915 as published (archive.org OCR text checked against the page scan; no correction); points from day 6 to the last morning weighing of the fast; split into early and late halves at the mid-time; k = (m_start - m_end)/((t_end - t_start) m_mean) in each half; r = k_late/k_early, r_lin = m_mean_early/m_mean_late. The script refuses to run unless this card is APPROVED and the data sha256 matches the manifest.

fixed_parameters: days 1-5 of the fast excluded as the human phase I (glycogen and early water loss); AI choice made before reading the table
Benedict's day numbering and weights as published; no smoothing, no correction
halves split at the mid-time of the window
thresholds 0.25 and 0.75 of the way from r = 1 to r_lin, on both sides of r = 1 (AI choices)
at least 4 points in the window, else INCONCLUSIVE
pass_criterion: PASS if |r - 1| <= 0.25 (r_lin - 1), i.e. the specific loss rate stays close to constant as D14's exponential leak requires.
fail_criterion: FAILED if r >= 1 + 0.75 (r_lin - 1) (specific rate rises nearly as much as constant burn requires) or r <= 1 - 0.75 (r_lin - 1) (specific rate falls by as much, i.e. the loss slows far faster than an exponential leak). INCONCLUSIVE otherwise, or with fewer than 4 points.

Body weight includes water, protein and fat, not the fat reserve alone; one subject, so no spread across individuals. The mapping of a body's reserves to the layer-3 pool and of a fast to 'closing the system' is an AI interpretation. Nearest theory: fasting physiology, first-order depletion. Not UET-distinct.
